title: 第三章：雨神还活着
content_zh:
许还山睁眼时，先听见的是自己的名字。

    不是有人在喊他。

    是有人在写他。

    一笔一划，落在看不见的账页上，像刀尖刮过骨头。

    许。

    还。

    山。

    第三个字落下的瞬间，他胸口那三百七十二枚血手印同时发烫，疼得他眼前一黑，险些再次跪下去。

    姜照雪一把扣住他的肩。

    “有人在远处开你的命灯。”

    许还山吸了口冷气，嘴上却没闲着。

    “听起来不像什么好事。”

    “本来就不是。”姜照雪盯着他的脸，“命灯一开，天债院就能定你的债籍。以后你走到哪里，他们都能顺着债息找到你。”

    许还山低头看了看自己胸口。

    衣襟下，血手印如烙铁般明灭。

    “那我现在算什么？”

    姜照雪道：“活人账本。”

    许还山沉默片刻，认真问：“值钱吗？”

    姜照雪看了他一眼。

    “很值钱。”

    许还山刚要松口气，姜照雪又补了一句：“但通常是按尸体估价。”

    “……”

    许还山叹道：“你们天债院说话，都这么不吉利？”

    姜照雪没有答。

    因为雨神像动了。

    那尊裂开的石像已经不能再称为神像。外层石皮大块脱落，里面露出的不是金身，也不是泥胎，而是一团青黑色的血肉。血肉里缠着香灰、符纸、发丝，还有一截截细小的白骨。

    它站在神台上，断臂处不断流出黑水。

    水落在地面，没有散开，而是化作一条条细蛇，沿着庙砖游动，绕向许还山的脚踝。

    雨神的声音比先前更低，也更恶毒。

    “既然你藏了本君的债，便替本君还。”

    许还山抬起算盘。

    剩下的七十二枚算盘珠悬在他身前，珠面血印跳动，却比刚才黯淡许多。

    以身藏账之后，他能调动死者债声，却也被三百七十二条命债压住。每动一次，都是在拿自己的魂魄磨刀。

    姜照雪低声道：“不能硬接。它在把香火债改成代偿债。只要改成，你就不是证人，是债务人。”

    “债务人会怎样？”

    “被收走寿数、气血、魂火，直到还清。”

    许还山看着地上越来越近的黑水蛇。

    “这账有点大啊。”

    “三百七十二条命。”

    “我一年到头挣不了几两银子，突然欠这么多，压力确实不小。”

    姜照雪终于忍不住皱眉：“你能不能别贫？”

    许还山咧嘴一笑。

    “不能。怕疼。”

    话音刚落，黑水蛇猛地弹起。

    姜照雪青白伞一旋，伞骨中滑出十二片薄刃，刃光如雪，将最前面的水蛇斩成数段。

    水蛇落地，却没有死，反而化成更多更细的黑线，钻入庙砖缝隙。

    天债院小吏趁机后退，想从庙门逃出去。

    许还山眼角一瞥，抬手拨动一枚算盘珠。

    “跑什么？”

    算盘珠落地，发出清脆一响。

    小吏脚下忽然浮现一圈血色账纹。

    他整个人像踩进泥潭，膝盖一软，险些摔倒。

    许还山道：“你刚才用镇债符封死人口供，这是公债还是私债？”

    小吏脸色煞白，怒道：“我奉院令行事！”

    “院令在哪？”

    “你没资格看！”

    许还山点点头。

    “那就是私债。”

    他手指再落。

    第二枚算盘珠转动。

    小吏左肩猛地一沉，像被一只看不见的手按住。他脸色剧变，肩骨发出咔的一声轻响。

    许还山疼得也闷哼一声。

    胸口一枚血手印裂开，像有烧红的针扎进心肺。

    姜照雪看向他：“别乱用。你现在借的是死者债力，反噬会先进你身。”

    许还山喘了口气。

    “知道。”

    “知道还用？”

    “他要跑。”

    “跑了可以再追。”

    许还山看着小吏，声音轻了些。

    “死人等不了。”

    姜照雪微微一怔。

    就在这一瞬，雨神像忽然张口。

    庙外悬停的雨珠齐齐倒飞而入。

    无数雨珠在半空凝成一支青黑色长枪，枪尖对准许还山心口。

    姜照雪脸色一变：“退！”

    许还山却没有退。

    他盯着那支雨枪，忽然问了一句：

    “神君，你到底怕什么？”

    雨神像眼中青光暴涨。

    雨枪破空而来。

    许还山抬手，将一张已经烧进皮肉里的债契虚影从胸口硬生生拽了出来。

    那是槐水村赵二的债契。

    血字残破，却还能看清最后一行：

    十年后偿寿七日。

    许还山把债契虚影往雨枪上一贴。

    “债源不明，收债暂停。”

    雨枪在距离他心口三寸处猛然停住。

    枪尖震颤，青黑雨水不断炸开，却再也刺不进半分。

    雨神像的脸第一次出现了明显的惊怒。

    “不可能！”

    许还山脸色苍白，手臂抖得厉害，却仍笑了一下。

    “你们天债院的律条，还是姜姑娘的玉牌好用。”

    姜照雪站在一旁，淡淡道：“不是我的玉牌好用，是它的账确实有问题。”

    许还山问：“问题在哪？”

    姜照雪盯着那支雨枪。

    “香火债有三个根。愿、契、偿。”

    许还山接道：“愿是百姓求雨，契是双方立约，偿是十年后还寿。”

    “对。”姜照雪道，“可这笔账少了一个东西。”

    “什么？”

    “神应。”

    许还山眼神一动。

    姜照雪继续道：“百姓向神明借雨，神必须真的降雨。降雨之后，债才成立。若神没有应愿，这笔债便是空债。”

    许还山低声道：“所以我刚才问它，十年前那场雨是不是它下的，它才会急。”
content_en:
When Xu Huanshan opened his eyes, the first thing he heard was his own name.
It wasn't someone calling him.
Someone is writing about him.
One stroke after another, it fell on the invisible account page, like the tip of a knife scraping across bones.
May.
return.
Mountain.
The moment the third word fell, the three hundred and seventy-two bloody handprints on his chest were hot at the same time. The pain made his eyes darken and he almost knelt down again.
Jiang Zhaoxue grabbed his shoulders.
"Someone is turning on your life light from a distance."
Xu Huanshan took a breath of cold air, but his mouth was not idle.
"That doesn't sound like a good thing."
"It wasn't originally." Jiang Zhaoxue stared at his face, "As soon as the life lamp is turned on, the Tianyiyuan will determine your debt. Wherever you go from now on, they will be able to find you by following the interest on your debt."
Xu Huanshan looked down at his chest.
Under the clothes, the bloody handprints flickered like a soldering iron.
"Then who am I now?"
Jiang Zhaoxue said: "Living account book."
Xu Huanshan was silent for a moment and asked seriously: "Is it worth it?"
Jiang Zhaoxue glanced at him.
"Very valuable."
Just as Xu Huanshan was about to breathe a sigh of relief, Jiang Zhaoxue added: "But the valuation is usually based on the corpse."
"..."
Xu Huanshan sighed: "Is everything you say in the Heavenly Debt Institute so unlucky?"
Jiang Zhaoxue didn't answer.
Because the rain statue moved.
The cracked stone statue can no longer be called a divine statue.Large pieces of the outer stone skin fell off, and what was exposed inside was not a golden body or a clay body, but a ball of blue-black flesh and blood.The flesh and blood was entangled with incense ash, talismans, hair, and pieces of tiny white bones.
It stood on the altar, with black water flowing out from its broken arm.
The water fell on the ground and did not disperse. Instead, it turned into thin snakes, swimming along the temple bricks and wrapping around Xu Huanshan's ankles.
The Rain God's voice was lower and more vicious than before.
"Since you hid my debt, you will repay it for me."
Xu Huanshan raised his abacus.
The remaining seventy-two abacus beads hung in front of him, and the blood marks on the beads were beating, but they were much dimmer than before.
After hiding his debt with his body, he was able to mobilize the debts of the dead, but he was also suppressed by the debts of 372 lives.Every time he moves, he is sharpening his sword with his own soul.
Jiang Zhaoxue whispered: "It can't be forced. It is changing the incense debt into a debt payment. As long as it is changed, you are not a witness, but a debtor."
“What happens to the debtor?”
"My lifespan, energy, blood, and soul fire were taken away until I pay them back."
Xu Huanshan looked at the black water snake getting closer and closer on the ground.
"This account is a bit big."
"Three hundred and seventy-two lives."
"I haven't earned a few taels of silver all year round, and suddenly I owe so much. It's really stressful."
Jiang Zhaoxue finally couldn't help but frown: "Can you stop being poor?"
Xu Huanshan grinned.
"No. I'm afraid of pain."
As soon as he finished speaking, the black water snake suddenly jumped up.
Jiang Zhaoxue's green and white umbrella twirled, and twelve thin blades slid out from the umbrella ribs. The blades were as bright as snow, and they chopped the water snake at the front into several pieces.
The water snake fell to the ground, but it did not die. Instead, it turned into more and thinner black lines and penetrated into the gaps between the temple bricks.
The clerk of Tianyiyuan took the opportunity to retreat and tried to escape through the temple gate.
Xu Huanshan glanced out of the corner of his eye and raised his hand to flick an abacus bead.
"What are you running for?"
The abacus beads fell to the ground and made a crisp sound.
Suddenly, a circle of bloody account lines appeared at the foot of the clerk.
He looked like he had stepped into a quagmire, his knees weakened and he almost fell.
Xu Huanshan said: "You just used the debt suppression charm to seal the confession. Is this a public debt or a private debt?"
The clerk's face turned pale and he said angrily: "I am acting on the orders of the court!"
"Where is the order?"
"You don't have the right to see it!"
Xu Huanshan nodded.
"That's private debt."
His fingers fell again.
The second abacus bead spins.
The clerk's left shoulder sank suddenly, as if being held down by an invisible hand.His expression changed drastically, and his shoulder bones made a soft crack.
Xu Huanshan groaned in pain.
A bloody handprint split open on his chest, like a red-hot needle piercing his heart and lungs.
Jiang Zhaoxue looked at him: "Don't use it indiscriminately. What you are borrowing now is the debt of the deceased, and the backlash will hit you first."
Xu Huanshan took a breath.
"Know."
"Is it still useful if you know it?"
"He's going to run."
"You can chase after you run away."
Xu Huanshan looked at the clerk and his voice became softer.
"The dead can't wait."
Jiang Zhaoxue was slightly startled.
At this moment, the Rain God Statue suddenly opened its mouth.
The raindrops hovering outside the temple all flew in.
Countless raindrops condensed into a blue-black spear in mid-air, and the tip of the spear pointed at Xu Huanshan's heart.
Jiang Zhaoxue's expression changed: "Back off!"
Xu Huanshan did not retreat.
He stared at the rain gun and suddenly asked:
"Shenjun, what are you afraid of?"
The blue light in the eyes of the Rain God statue surged.
Rain guns came through the sky.
Xu Huanshan raised his hand and pulled out the phantom of the debt contract that had been burned into his flesh from his chest.
That was the debt deed of Zhao Er of Huaishui Village.
The words in blood are broken, but the last line can still be read clearly:
After ten years, his life span will be seven days.
Xu Huanshan put the shadow of the debt deed on the rain gun.
"The source of the debt is unknown and debt collection is suspended."
The rain gun suddenly stopped three inches away from his heart.
The tip of the spear trembled, and green and black rain continued to explode, but it could no longer penetrate even half a point.
For the first time, the Rain God Statue's face showed obvious shock and anger.
"impossible!"
Xu Huanshan's face was pale and his arms were shaking violently, but he still smiled.
"Miss Jiang's jade token is more effective than the laws of your Heavenly Debt Institute."
Jiang Zhaoxue stood aside and said calmly: "It's not that my jade token is easy to use, but that there is indeed a problem with its account."
Xu Huanshan asked: "What's the problem?"
Jiang Zhaoxue stared at the rain gun.
"Incense debt has three roots: wish, contract, and repayment."
Xu Huanshan continued: "The wish is for the people to pray for rain, the contract is for both parties to make a covenant, and the repayment is for life to return in ten years."
"Yes." Jiang Zhaoxue said, "But there is one thing missing from this account."
"What?"
"God responds."
Xu Huanshan's eyes moved.
Jiang Zhaoxue continued: "People borrow rain from the gods, and the gods must actually rain. After the rainfall, the debt is established. If the gods do not fulfill their wishes, the debt will be empty."
Xu Huanshan whispered: "That's why I asked it just now if it was responsible for the rain ten years ago that made it anxious."
title_en: Chapter 3: The Rain God is still alive
